  SPECIAL MEETING

 NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL
  (Government Code Section 54956)

  TO THE MEMBERS OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL

  NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor that a special meeting of the City
  Council will be held on Tuesday, June 29, 2021, at 5:30 P.M., in the Council
Chambers, One Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, California (Government Code
  Section 54956).

*****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19
  health emergency and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and
 *****NOTE FROM THE CITY: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION: Due to the existing COVID-19
  health emergency and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and
 pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20 (https://www.gov.ca.gov/wp-
  content/uploads/2020/03/3.17.20-N-29-20-EO.pdf).

Please note that members of the public will be allowed to observe and/or address
  the City Council at the Special Meeting of June 29, 2021, at 5:30 P.M. for open
  session as follows:

  1.  Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit
  comments electronically for consideration by the Inglewood City
  Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Parking
  Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to
  the City Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and
  Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure
  distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to
  consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 11:00
  A.M. the day of the meeting, and in the body of the email, please
  identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence should
  indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after
  11:00 A.M. and prior to the close of the public hearings, will be made
  part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of
  the City Clerk at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

  2. By Telephone-Listening to the Meeting and Making Oral Public
  Comments: Members of the public can participate in the meeting by
  telephone to listen and make comments noting the following:

  l  If you are dialing in from a cell phone, please call from an area with

  l  If you are watching the meeting via Social Media or Channel 35 while

  ACCESSIBILITY: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made
available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required
by Section 202 of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132),

email to athompson@cityofinglewood.org and aallen@cityofinglewood.org no later

Inglewood, California
  June 29, 2021

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Tuesday,
  June 29, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into at the hour of 6:07 p.m.
  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Dotson, Morales, Faulk,
  and Mayor Butts; and
  Absent:  Council Member Padilla
  City Authority officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any
  persons present who wished to address the City Council on any item on the Agenda.
  Caller (Name Unknown) commented on Agenda Item Nos. 1, Advance Funds Agreement
  with Murphy’s Bowl LLC, 3, Amended and Restated City of Inglewood Parking
  Facilities and Shuttle Services Operation and Management Agreement with LAZ Parking
  California, LLC. She also commented on the time the Special Meeting was held.

301  AGREEMENT NO. 21-83 APPROVED – MURPHY’S BOWL LLC;
  RESOLUTION NO. 21-102 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2020-
  2021 BUDGET; PAYMENT AUTHORIZED - TRIFILETTI CONSULTING INC.;
  AGREEMENT NO. 21-184 APPROVED – TRIFILETTI CONSULTING INC. Staff
  report dated June 29, 2021, was presented recommending approval of an Advance Funds
  Agreement with Murphy’s Bowl LLC in the amount of $80,000 to cover the cost of
  services associated with Environmental Impact Report (EIR) mitigation monitoring
  requirements for the Inglewood Basketball and Entertainment Center (IBEC), including
  the cost of certain City-approved consultants engaged by the City to assist with such
  services.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Agreement No. 21-83; 2) Adopt Resolution
  No. 21-102 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD AMENDING THE 2020-2021 ANNUAL BUDGET TO
  COVER THE COST OF CONSULTING SERVICES ASSOCIATED
  WITH ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT MITIGATION
  MONITORING

  3) Authorize payment in the amount of $4,799.85 to Trifiletti Consulting Inc. (Trifiletti)
  for certain Post EIR environmental services performed and invoiced by Trifiletti at the
  request of the City and approved by Murphy’s Bowl; and 4) Approve Agreement No. 21-
  184 in the amount of $60,200.15 with Trifiletti Consulting Inc. (Trifiletti), for post EIR
  mitigation measure outside agency coordination. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Padilla.
   June 29, 2021

142  AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO AGREEMENT NO. 20 - 056 APPROVED –
  ARAMARK UNIFORM & CAREER APPAREL, LLC. Staff report dated June 29,
  2021, was presented recommending approval of Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 20-
  056 with Aramark Uniform & Career Apparel, LLC, extending the term of the agreement
  by one year (with the option to extend an additional year) to provide garments, towels,
  mats, and mops for the city employees.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by the Council Member Faulk
  that the City Council does hereby approve Amendment No. 1 to Agreement No. 20-056
  in an amount not to exceed $114,500. The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Padilla.

183  AGREEMENT NO. 20-083 APPROVED – LAZ PARKING CALIFORNIA, LLC;
  MAYOR AUTHORIZED – EXECUTION OF AMENDED AGREEMENT AND
  ANY ANCILLARY AGREEMENTS NECESSARY ON BEHALF OF THE CITY;
  PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR AUTHORIZED – EXECUTION OF CHANGE
  ORDERS. Staff report dated June 29, 2021, was presented recommending approval of
  the Amended and Restated City of Inglewood Parking Facilities and Shuttle Services
  Operation and Management Agreement (Amended Contract) with LAZ Parking
  California, LLC (LAZ) to document operational and financial refinements to the City’s
  remote parking and shuttle program operated by LAZ for football games and other major
  events within the City’s Sports and Entertainment District (i.e., SoFi Stadium, Hollywood
  Park, The Forum, and the future Inglewood Basketball and Entertainment Center).

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve the Amended and Restated City of Inglewood
  Parking Facilities and Shuttle Services Operation and Management Agreement No. 20-
  083; 2) Authorize the Mayor to execute the Amended Contract on behalf of the City of
  Inglewood (City); 3) Authorize the Mayor to execute any ancillary agreements necessary
  to perfect the City’s security interest in the operating account maintained by LAZ
  pursuant to the Amended Contract; 4) Approve a change order under the Amended
  Contract to expand LAZ’s services to cover up to 20 major events during the 2021-2022
  operating year (Change Order); and 5) Authorize the Director of Public Works to execute
  the Change Order. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members, Dotson, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None: and
  Absent: Council Member Padilla.

183  RESOLUTION NO. 21 – 103 ADOPTED – APPROVAL OF LOAN FROM CITY’S
  GENERAL FUND TO THE PARKING FUND; MAYOR AUTHORIZED TO SIGN
  PROMISSORY NOTE OF THE INDEBTEDNESS OF THE PARKING FUND;
  RESOLUTION NO. 21 – 104 ADOPTED – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR
  2020-2021 BUDGET; CONTRACT AWARDED AND AGREEMENT NO. 21-190
  APPROVED - SUPERIOR PAVEMENT MARKINGS, INC. Staff report dated June
  29, 2021, was presented recommending adoption of a resolution approving a loan from
  the City’s General Fund to the Parking Fund for implementation of the City’s Traffic
  Management and Operations Plan in the amount of $2,416,489.

  It was moved by the Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk
  that the City Council does hereby: 1) Adopt Resolution No. 21-103 entitled:

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  INGLEWOOD, APPROVING A LOAN IN THE AMOUNT OF
  $2,394,489 FROM THE CITY’S GENERAL FUND TO THE
  AUTHORITY’S PARKING FUND FOR IMPLEMENTATION OF THE
  CITY’S TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT AND OPERATIONS PLAN.

  2) Authorize the Mayor to sign the Promissory Note of Indebtedness of the Parking Fund
  to the General Fund Reserve; 3) Adopt Resolution No. 21-104 entitled:

  2
   June 29, 2021

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF THE
  INGLEWOOD AMENDING THE 2020-2021 ANNUAL BUDGET TO
  PROVIDE FUNDING TO ENGAGE A CONTRACTOR TO
  COMPLETE THE CITY’S TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT AND
  OPERATIONS PLAN.

  and; 4) Award a contract and approve Agreement No. 21-190 (with an option to extend
  an additional three (3)-year term) with Superior Pavement Markings, Inc. to provide
  pavement delineation services in an amount not to exceed $2,416,489 (includes a ten
  percent (10%) contingency in the amount of $219,681) for the Pavement Delineation
  Services Project, per Bid No. CB-21-04. The motion was carried by the following roll
  call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members, Dotson, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Padilla.

183  AGREEMENT NO. 21-185 APPROVED – BHAGAT INVESTMENTS, LLC. Staff
  report dated June 29, 2021, was presented recommending approval of a Development
  Agreement between Bhagat Investments, LLC (Developer) and the City regarding the
  proposed sale and development of certain City-owned land generally located at 3700 W.
  Century Boulevard (Property) for a hotel development.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk, that
  the City Council does hereby approve Agreement No. 21-185. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members, Dotson, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Council Member Padilla.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned at the hour of 6:13 p.m.

  Approved this ______ day of _______, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
